stem: Meera's teacher asks the class what happens to food after most nutrients have been digested and absorbed in the small intestine. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The digested nutrients move into the large intestine to be absorbed there.
The undigested food passes through the small intestine wall into the blood vessels.
The remaining undigested food moves into the large intestine.
The undigested food moves back from the large intestine into the small intestine.

teacher.key_rationale: After digestion and absorption are completed in the small intestine, only the undigested residue remains, and it passes into the large intestine where water is absorbed. Option C states this correctly. Option A reverses the direction of nutrient movement, B conflates absorption of digested nutrients with undigested food crossing the gut wall, and D reverses the order of the organs.
